signature.name: VTask.removeBot
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {s : α} -> [CompleteLattice α] -> (P : Set α) -> (indep : sSupIndep P) -> (sSup_eq : sSup P = s) -> Partition s

conventions.statement: The parts of the resulting Partition are exactly P \ {⊥}; if ⊥ ∈ P it is silently dropped, and if ⊥ ∉ P the set is unchanged.
conventions.note: This is the defining construction: ⊥ is always excluded from parts regardless of whether it was present.
